description: Web MVP Closed Loop - Deliver the remaining PRD MVP as a Cargo-native web-first, local-first product: import papers, read block-by-block, translate/explain selections, annotate text, restore progress, and auto-collect vocabulary.

userStories.title: Scaffold the Cargo-native web app crate with route placeholders
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a new Rust/WASM web-app crate wired into the Cargo workspace with route modules for library, import, reading, vocabulary, and settings.
acceptanceCriteria: crates/web-app/Cargo.toml exists and is a workspace member
Route modules exist: library, import, read, vocabulary, settings
App shell compiles with route placeholders and navigation
scripts/run_web_app.sh exists as startup helper
cargo test --test web_app_workspace_smoke passes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add browser-local IndexedDB persistence for all MVP entities
userStories.description: As a developer, I need local browser storage for papers, blocks, reading progress, annotations, vocabulary, AI records, and settings so the app works offline.
acceptanceCriteria: Storage modules exist under crates/web-app/src/storage/ with schema, IndexedDB wrapper, and per-entity repos
Domain types Annotation and VocabularyItem added to crates/core
Paper, Block, and ReadingProgress round-trip through storage
Vocabulary upsert increments lookup_count instead of duplicating
cargo test --test web_storage_round_trip passes
cargo test --test web_vocabulary_round_trip passes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement import flow for pasted text and local PDFs
userStories.description: As a user, I want to import a paper by pasting text or uploading a PDF so that I can read it in the immersive reader.
acceptanceCriteria: Paste-text import creates a Paper, Blocks, and initial ReadingProgress at index 0
PDF import stores the original file locally, extracts text via vendored pdf.js bridge, normalizes into blocks, and transitions paper to ReadyText
New papers appear in the library view with status and progress summary
cargo test --test web_import_paste_flow passes
cargo test --test web_import_pdf_flow passes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build the immersive reading loop with progress tracking and restore
userStories.description: As a user, I want to navigate blocks with previous/next controls and have my reading position restored when I reopen a paper.
acceptanceCriteria: Next/previous block navigation updates stored current_block_index on each move
Progress indicator shows block index and percentage
Reloading the app restores the last-saved block instead of resetting to block 0
cargo test --test web_block_navigation passes
cargo test --test web_reading_progress_restore passes
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add selection annotations with resilient anchors and vocabulary auto-collection
userStories.description: As a user, I want to highlight and annotate text selections, and have looked-up terms automatically saved to my vocabulary list.
acceptanceCriteria: Selection popover offers annotate action on selected text
Annotations store quote, prefix/suffix context, block hint, and offsets for resilient re-anchoring
Annotations survive reload and reattach to the same paper/block
Lookup events upsert vocabulary entries with incremented lookup_count (no duplicates)
Vocabulary route lists all saved entries
cargo test --test web_annotation_round_trip passes
cargo test --test web_vocabulary_auto_collect passes
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Expand the gateway with AI translation and explanation endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the gateway to expose POST /api/translate and POST /api/explain endpoints backed by an injectable AI client so the web app can request AI assistance.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/translate accepts selected text, type, source/target language, and context; returns structured JSON with translation text and normalized term
POST /api/explain accepts selected text, explanation type (term|sentence), language, and context; returns structured JSON with explanation, optional background, and optional caution
Gateway loads config from environment variables (bind address, AI key, token)
Structured tracing logs written to logs/YYYY-MM-DD_HHMMSS.log
docs/runtime-config.md documents required environment variables
scripts/run_gateway.sh exists as standard startup entrypoint
cargo test --test gateway_translate_contract passes
cargo test --test gateway_explain_contract passes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Wire translation and explanation into the reading experience
userStories.description: As a user, I want to select text in the reading view and get AI-powered translations or explanations displayed in a side panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting text in the reading view shows a popover with translate and explain actions
Translation action calls the gateway, persists the result as an AI record, and renders a bilingual result in the translation panel
Explanation action calls the gateway and renders the response in the AI panel using the configured explanation language
Settings route controls explanation language preference
When gateway is unavailable, reading stays functional and AI controls show an explicit disabled/retry state
cargo test --test web_selection_translate_flow passes
cargo test --test web_explain_panel_flow passes
cargo test --test web_ai_offline_state passes
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Harden the MVP with library summaries, error states, and documentation
userStories.description: As a user, I want the library to show paper summaries, import failures to be recoverable, and the project to have clear startup documentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Library view lists each paper with title, source type, status, and progress summary
Failed PDF extraction leaves a visible failed-paper state with a retry action (no silent data loss)
README.md documents MVP startup instructions and the split web/gateway architecture
docs/plans/INDEX.md, progress.txt, and lesson.md reflect milestone completion
cargo test --test web_library_listing passes
cargo test --test web_import_error_state passes
cargo fmt --check passes
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings passes
cargo test --workspace passes
Typecheck passes
